pairs: Et vidi in dextera sedentis supra thronum,
And in the right hand of the One sitting upon the throne,
And I saw a strong Angel,
“Who is worthy to open the book
Et nemo poterat neque in cælo,
And no one was able, neither in heaven,
nor under the earth, to open the book,
Et ego flebam multum, quoniam nemo dignus inventus est aperire librum,
And I wept greatly because no one was found worthy to open the book,
Et unus de senioribus dixit mihi:
And one of the elders said to me:
ecce vicit leo de tribu Juda,
the lion from the tribe of Judah,
has prevailed to open the book and to break its seven seals.”
in the midst of the throne and the four living creatures,
and in the midst of the elders,
having seven horns and seven eyes,
which are the seven spirits of God,
sent forth to all the earth.
et accepit de dextera sedentis in throno librum.
and received the book from the right hand of the One sitting upon the throne.
And when he had opened the book,
et viginti quatuor seniores ceciderunt coram Agno,
and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb,
as well as golden bowls full of fragrances,
which are the prayers of the saints.
And they were singing a new canticle,
accipere librum, et aperire signacula ejus:
you are worthy to receive the book and to open its seals,
quoniam occisus es, et redemisti nos Deo in sanguine tuo ex omni tribu,
because you were slain and have redeemed us for God, by your blood,
et lingua, et populo, et natione:
from every tribe and language and people and nation.
et fecisti nos Deo nostro regnum,
And you have made us into a kingdom
and into priests for our God,
and we shall reign over the earth.”
et audivi vocem angelorum multorum in circuitu throni,
and I heard the voice of many Angels surrounding the throne
et erat numerus eorum millia millium,
(and their number was thousands of thousands)
Dignus est Agnus, qui occisus est, accipere virtutem,
“The Lamb who was slain is worthy to receive power,
And every creature that is in heaven,
and all that is within the sea:
“To the One sitting upon the throne
and to the Lamb be blessing,
And the four living creatures were saying,
Et viginti quatuor seniores ceciderunt in facies suas:
And the twenty-four elders fell down on their faces,
et adoraverunt viventem in sæcula sæculorum.
and they adored the One who lives forever and ever.
